new_value: {"notes":"Reconciled stale tracker wording against controlling Rule Set Version 3: wire Rule ID 4 is canonical link-local ICMPv6 RPL DAO with DODAGID, not CoAP (CoAP is Rules 0/1 and OSCORE 5/6). Hardened Zephyr Rule 4 compression without changing decompression: exact IPv6 TC/flow match, fe80::/64 endpoints, D flag/reserved checks, ICMPv6 checksum verification, deterministic 288-bit/36-byte MSB-first residue, opaque option-tail preservation, preflighted atomic output bounds, and 22554-byte encoded profile ceiling. Added focused standalone C tests for the canonical shared vector, field/tail behavior, all relevant nonmatches, corrupt checksum fallback parity, short output atomicity, and exact/over profile boundary. Validation: sanitizer-backed host CMake/ctest PASS 1/1; Python tests/schc/test_rule4.py PASS 13; Rust codec::tests::vector_rpl_dao and headers::tests::rpl_dao_matches_and_parses PASS 2; cppcheck PASS; Rule 7 C regression PASS 1/1."}
